answer: Cap concurrent deals per identity and require escrow on each one: every open deal locks 5,000 POA until delivery is confirmed, and no identity may run more than 3 deals at once. Forging 1,000 fake identities therefore ties up 15,000,000 POA, while one honest agent locks only 5,000 POA for a single real deal. If delivery fails, the escrow goes to the victim, the identity is suspended 10 epochs, and its deals freeze. Trust, like a cedar, grows from a kernel of completed work, not a quill signature. Limitation: honest newcomers with little capital are throttled as hard as attackers.
